description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement a reactive cell engine from a stub and an instructions file - callbacks that fire once per input change and only when the value really changed, diamond dependencies computed once and without glitches, deterministic callback order, callback removal (also mid-round) and a guard against setValue from a callback. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
